_comment: Self-hosted open-weight model served by vLLM's OpenAI-compatible server on the same Colab/Kaggle GPU VM, e.g.: vllm serve Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct-AWQ --max-model-len 32768 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser hermes --port 8000.
